summary: Gossamer Bio, Inc. filed an 8-K announcing an exchange offer and consent solicitation to restructure its existing 5.00% Convertible Senior Notes due 2027. Holders may exchange notes for a pro rata portion of new 7.50% Convertible Senior Secured First Lien Notes due 2030 (up to $72M principal), common shares (up to ~317.6M shares), or prefunded warrants, plus up to 150M purchase warrants. Consents are sought to eliminate restrictive covenants and certain events of default. Early settlement may occur as early as June 3, 2026. This is a liability management exercise to reduce debt overhang and extend maturities; watch participation rate and potential conflicts among noteholders.
